design_description: A clean and sporty royal-blue design accented with vibrant yellow side panels and shoulder curves that create a sense of speed and motion. The layout is minimalist, letting the bold Road Trip 2026 Sweden Edition typography take center stage while maintaining a strong football identity through the crest and structured silhouette. Thin yellow trims on the sleeves and dynamic curved inserts give the jersey a retro touring and training-kit vibe, almost inspired by travel capsules or pre-season event apparel. Overall, the design feels energetic, accessible, and adventure-oriented — a modern football shirt with strong road-trip and fan-tour culture influences.
